visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and a yellow sleeveless dress enters through a white door into a room, carrying a large white POP MART shopping bag. The room has light-colored walls and a white multi-tiered shelf on the left. (2) She sits down and holds up a large rectangular box with colorful 'Labubu' graphics. She uses her hands to peel off tape and open the lid, revealing several smaller pink boxes inside. (3) She takes out a single pink box, shows the side illustrations to the camera, and then tears open a silver foil bag inside. (4) She reveals a purple and light blue fuzzy plush toy with pointed ears. She moves it close to the lens to show its glittery purple eyes and soft fur texture. (5) She unboxes a bright pink plush toy and points to its forehead, showing the way the fur lays near its eyebrows. She then holds up a collectible card featuring the same character. (6) She continues the process for four more plushies in colors like dark pink, light green, orange, and light blue, showing the front and back of each while gesturing towards their specific features. (7) Finally, she holds a string of all six colorful plushies hanging together and then poses with three of them—orange, green, and purple—which she points to as her favorites.
